title: Pulmonary Diagnostics I
description: Pulmonary function testing fundamentals: spirometry, flow-volume loops, lung volumes, DLCO, bronchoprovocation, CPX, MVV, respiratory muscle strength, FeNO, walk testing, oxygen titration, bronchoscopy, and sleep studies.

lessons.title: Spirometry & Post-Bronchodilator Studies
lessons.description: Pulmonary function testing overview with spirometry indications, contraindications, hazards, equipment, patient preparation, ATS acceptability criteria, core values, flow-volume loop interpretation, and post-bronchodilator testing.

lessons.title: Lung Volume Studies
lessons.description: Pulmonary function testing methods that measure FRC, including nitrogen washout, helium dilution, and body plethysmography; lung volume calculations; restrictive, obstructive, and combined interpretation; and airway resistance/conductance values from VTG.

resources.title: Respiratory | Spirometry: Lung Volumes & Capacities
resources.description: Use this first for the core vocabulary: VT, IRV, ERV, RV, FRC, VC, IC, and TLC.

resources.title: Lung Volumes by Body Plethysmography: Unraveling the Mysteries of the Box
resources.description: Best match for VTG/body box mechanics, Boyle's law, panting against the shutter, and trapped gas.

resources.title: Clinical Application of Total Body Plethysmography: Airway Mechanics Measurements
resources.description: Targets the Raw, Gaw, sRaw, and sGaw section of the lesson.

resources.title: Is There Only One Way to Measure Vital Capacity During Lung Volume Testing?
resources.description: Good companion for SVC, VC, and how volume maneuvers fit into lung volume testing.

resources.title: Pulmonary Lung Function Test Interpretation
resources.description: Use this after the lesson to reinforce obstruction, restriction, air trapping, and hyperinflation patterns.

lessons.title: Lung Diffusion & Bronchoprovocation Studies
lessons.description: DLCO testing with single-breath technique, test gas composition, analyzers, ATS acceptability/reproducibility, DL/VA interpretation, and bronchoprovocation testing with methacholine and exercise-induced bronchospasm protocols.

resources.title: Pulmonary Function Tests (PFT): Lesson 4 - DLCO
resources.description: Best overview for DLCO interpretation, decreased diffusion capacity, and how DLCO fits into PFT interpretation.

resources.title: What is a Single Breath Diffusion Capacity Test?
resources.description: Patient-facing walk-through of the single-breath DLCO maneuver and breath-hold concept.

resources.title: Taking a DLCO test with the EasyOne Pro
resources.description: Useful visual companion for DLCO setup, patient coaching, inhalation, breath hold, and exhalation.

resources.title: The Methacholine Challenge Test: Why and How?
resources.description: ATS video that pairs well with the methacholine indication, safety, procedure, and positive-response sections.

resources.title: Exercise Induced Asthma Explained by a Respiratory Therapist
resources.description: Companion overview for the EIA/EIB portion of the lesson, especially symptoms and exercise-triggered bronchospasm.

lessons.title: CPX, MVV & Respiratory Muscle Strength
lessons.description: Cardiopulmonary exercise testing, maximum voluntary ventilation, and MIP/MEP testing with indications, contraindications, equipment, procedures, values, and interpretation.

lessons.title: FeNO, Timed Walk Testing & Exercise Oxygen Titration
lessons.description: Exhaled nitric oxide testing, timed walk testing, and oxygen titration with exercise, including indications, preparation, procedure, values, interpretation, contraindications, and hazards.

lessons.title: Bronchoscopy, Sputum Induction & Sleep Studies
lessons.description: Bronchoscopy indications, equipment, procedure support, sputum induction, polysomnography, CPAP/BiPAP titration, home sleep testing, actigraphy, MSLT, and MWT.

lessons.title: Module Overview & Exam Review
lessons.description: High-yield Pulmonary Diagnostics I review with a fillable RESC 2340 worksheet resource for exam prep.

resources.description: Companion spirometry video for forced vital capacity maneuvers and interpretation.
